title: Answer: a self is a living person, a route of presiding occasions

statements.text: A self is not an enduring substance but a living person: a route of presiding occasions, each inheriting from the last, that wanders through the brain. No subject experiences twice, and personal dominance is only partial, which allows for dissociation.

sources.quote: in the case of the higher animals there is central direction, which suggests that in their case each animal body harbours a living person, or living persons
This route of presiding occasions probably wanders from part to part of the brain
